item.title: Yakushima: When an Island Becomes a Refuge for Loggerhead Sea Turtles
item.description: This article explores the conservation challenges facing loggerhead sea turtles in Yakushima, a major Japanese nesting site, by examining the threats facing the species and the actions needed to ensure the long-term protection of its nesting beaches.

item.title: Introduction to the BiOdyssée association
item.description:
BiOdyssée is an association dedicated to the protection of biodiversity.

It explores conservation initiatives around the world to understand the issues, methods and impacts.
